current_default: Shared fixed-branch symmetric inverse-square-root and pseudoinverse first-order response. The compiler owns the serialized rules and emits their shared runtime-sized CUDA lowering; native consumers retain eigensystem ownership, branch validation, scratch, streams, and launch integration.
generated_capability: SymmetricMatrixFunctionSpec emits ordinary TensorIR response programs for inverse_sqrt and pseudoinverse, including retained/discarded subspace motion and full-Frobenius transpose semantics.
missing_capability: Direct dynamic-shape TensorIR execution is not yet available; the compiler-owned custom-rule emitter provides the runtime-sized CUDA lowering without generating BLAS/eigensolver/allocation/runtime policy.
retirement_condition: Replace the dynamic adapter only after compiler/runtime dynamic-shape custom-rule dispatch reproduces fixed-rank branch semantics and passes complete DF force/resource gates; do not restore a method-local spectral kernel.
